subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should ordinary assistant-stage timeouts use one same-profile retry before existing auth-profile rotation and model fallback for all existing configurations?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the established failover ordering for a user-visible reliability path; code review cannot determine the preferred latency, provider-quota, and fallback tradeoff without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt the bounded retry
options.body: Accept one same-profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts, contingent on exact-head runtime and transcript proof.

options.title: Keep immediate rotation
options.body: Retain the current failover ordering so ordinary timeouts continue to consume the next auth-profile or fallback candidate immediately.

options.title: Narrow the policy
options.body: Apply the retry only to a maintainer-approved subset of timeout conditions after defining the supported contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bounded retry
recommendation.body: Accept one same-profile retry for ordinary assistant timeouts, contingent on exact-head runtime and transcript proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged timeout-failover work is the closest established behavior this PR alters.
